_comment: P12 §12 human-evaluation corpus. Purpose is stated in §12: avoid optimising against Thomas Calculus alone. Each entry records what a reader expects the pipeline to find, so a run can be compared against an expectation that was written before the run rather than extracted after it.
coverage_gap: §12 asks for mathematics, physics, biology, humanities and textbook. The local warehouse has no biology or chemistry title with extracted text, so those two disciplines are represented by physics-adjacent and humanities titles instead. Recorded rather than papered over; see _missing_disciplines.
